title: Hydrothermal synthesis of Ag@Zn-salen MOF nanocomposite via a two-step method for ultrasensitive CA15-3 biosensing in breast cancer diagnostics
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,34149-34159
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA04548G, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Ahmed Galal Eldin, Ekram H. Mohamed, Said M. El-Sheikh, Sheta M. Sheta, Ahmed O. Youssef, Esraa Elshahat, Mohamed S. Attia, Mona N. Abou-Omar
This work presents a scalable synthesis for a uniform Ag NP@Zn-salen MOF composite. Functionalized with antibodies, it enables ultrasensitive CA15-3 biomarker detection.
